plan.text:
Build the Execution Mode pi extension at ~/.pi/agent/extensions/execution-mode/ with 4 files:
1. sidecar.ts - Atomic read/write of {project}/.pi/execution-mode.json
2. prompts.ts - System prompt injection templates  
3. safety.ts - Loop detection, response length checks
4. index.ts - Main extension wiring all hooks, tools, commands together

phases.name: Build sidecar.ts - atomic state file operations
Build index.ts - main extension wiring everything together
